DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.covid_tracking_ext_table;


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.covid_tracking_ext_table
(
    date DATE,
    state VARCHAR(10),
    positive BIGINT,
    negative BIGINT,
    pending BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCurrently BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCumulative BIGINT,
    inIcuCurrently BIGINT,
    inIcuCumulative BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCurrently BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCumulative BIGINT,
    recovered BIGINT,
    death BIGINT,
    totalTestResults BIGINT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'inputdata/covid_tracking.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source_practice,
    FILE_FORMAT = external_parquet_file
);



SELECT * FROM 
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'inputdata/covid_tracking.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source_practice',
    FORMAT='PARQUET'
) AS QUERY1;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.Electric_Vehicle_Population_Ext_table
(
    [VIN (1-10)] VARCHAR(10),
    County VARCHAR(100),
    City VARCHAR(100),
    State VARCHAR(10),
    [Postal Code] VARCHAR(10),
    [Model Year] INT,
    Make VARCHAR(100),
    Model VARCHAR(100),
    [Electric Vehicle Type] VARCHAR(100),
    [Clean Alternative Fuel Vehicle (CAFV) Eligibility] VARCHAR(150),
    [Electric Range] INT,
    [Base MSRP] INT,
    [Legislative District] INT,
    [DOL Vehicle ID] BIGINT,
    [Vehicle Location] VARCHAR(200),
    [Electric Utility] VARCHAR(200),
    [2020 Census Tract] BIGINT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'inputdata/Electric_Vehicle_Population_Data_1.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source_practice,
    FILE_FORMAT = external_csv_file
);

DROP EXTERNAL TABLE  dbo.Electric_Vehicle_Population_Ext_table;


SELECT * FROM 
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'inputdata/Electric_Vehicle_Population_Data_1.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source_practice',
    FORMAT='CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;

CREATE MASTER KEY ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'pass@123';

--CREATE CREADIANCIAL
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL SynapseCreds
WITH
     IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';
    

    --EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
    CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_Ext_source
    WITH
    (
        LOCATION = 'https://azuresynapse05.blob.core.windows.net/raw',

    );

--https://azuresynapse05.blob.core.windows.net/raw/reveune/Brokennames.csv

    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source',
    FORMAT='CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',

SELECT * FROM 
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'reveune/Brokennames.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source',
    FORMAT='CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',

-- This is auto-generated code
SELECT TOP 100
    jsonContent 
/* --> place the keys that you see in JSON documents in the WITH clause:
       , JSON_VALUE (jsonContent, '$.key1') AS header1
       , JSON_VALUE (jsonContent, '$.key2') AS header2
*/
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://azuresynapse05.dfs.core.windows.net/externaldatasource/inputdata/covid_tracking_1.json',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        FIELDQUOTE = '0x0b',
        FIELDTERMINATOR ='0x0b',
        ROWTERMINATOR = '0x0b'
    )
    WITH (
        jsonContent varchar(MAX)
    ) AS [result]

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.covid_tracking_json_ext_table
(
    date DATE,
    state VARCHAR(10),
    positive BIGINT,
    negative BIGINT,
    pending BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCurrently BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCumulative BIGINT,
    inIcuCurrently BIGINT,
    inIcuCumulative BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCurrently BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCumulative BIGINT,
    recovered BIGINT,
    death BIGINT,
    totalTestResults BIGINT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'inputdata/covid_tracking_1.json',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source_practice,
    FILE_FORMAT = Json_As_Csv_File_Format
)



SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'inputdata/covid_tracking_1.json,
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source_practice',
    FORMAT = '',
    FIELDTERMINATOR = '0x0b',
    FIELDQUOTE = '0x0b'
) AS Query1;




SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'inputdata/covid_tracking_1.json',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source_practice',
    FORMAT = 'JSON',
    FIELDTERMINATOR = '0x0b',
    FIELDQUOTE = '0x0b'
)
WITH (
    [date] VARCHAR(20),
    [state] VARCHAR(10),
    [positive] VARCHAR(20),
    [negative] VARCHAR(20),
    [pending] VARCHAR(20),
    [hospitalizedCurrently] VARCHAR(20),
    [hospitalizedCumulative] VARCHAR(20),
    [inIcuCurrently] VARCHAR(20),
    [inIcuCumulative] VARCHAR(20),
    [onVentilatorCurrently] VARCHAR(20),
    [onVentilatorCumulative] VARCHAR(20),
    [recovered] VARCHAR(20),
    [death] VARCHAR(20),
    [totalTestResults] VARCHAR(20)
) AS rows;
